description: One of an ask's buttons, as its task gives it: pressing it tells the task, with the form's values. Sized to its label, wrapping with the others as a whole.

style.description: How it's drawn: primary (the accent), secondary (plain, the default), or one of the accent palette's colours (schema/tokens accent.*).

picture.description: One of the ask's pictures, by its name, drawn over its label: a picture button.
